summary: Futu Holdings filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, to report its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing discloses operational and financial highlights, including a 24.7% year-over-year increase in total revenues to HK$5,856.0 million and a 34.3% increase in total funded accounts to 3,590,325. The press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, provides standard quarterly performance metrics such as trading volume, client assets, and margin financing balances. This is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 2.02 disclosure of results of operations and financial condition. No special-situation event is involved; the filing is purely informational and does not trigger any corporate action. There are no deal terms or strategic changes to monitor.
